en: Vintage monochrome postcard view of a straight, elegant street lined with multi‑story residential buildings with classical facades. People, including children and a man with a cart, stand in the middle of the quiet street. In the background, framed by mountains, there is a church-like building with a round rose window and a bulbous dome-topped bell tower. At the top in red lettering it reads: "Trento — Via Alessandro Vittoria."
